verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents building custom dashboards. It covers adjacent pieces only: evaluations attached to spans and submitted via SDK/API, cost and usage analysis for AI agents in Agent Console, and a community mention of custom search dimensions. None of these shows a dashboard builder over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
